name: Geometric Wall Pattern
instruction: Design a geometric wall pattern. Start with a series of hexagons arranged in a honeycomb structure. Add smaller triangles inside each hexagon. Connect the triangles with lines to form a star shape within each hexagon. Ensure the pattern is seamless and can repeat across a large surface.

Shape accuracy: The pattern consists of a series of hexagons.
Each hexagon is arranged in a honeycomb structure.
Smaller triangles are placed inside each hexagon.
Lines connect the triangles to form a star shape within each hexagon.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The triangles should fit well within the hexagons.
The star shape should be centered within each hexagon.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The hexagons are arranged in a flat, two-dimensional plane.
The triangles are positioned correctly within the hexagons.
The star shapes are well-defined and do not overlap with the edges of the hexagons.
Object distance and contact: There is no gap between adjacent hexagons.
The triangles are fully contained within their respective hexagons.
The lines connecting the triangles do not extend beyond the hexagon boundaries.

Instruction execution accuracy: All specified elements of the pattern are accurately represented.
The seamless nature of the pattern is maintained for repeatability.
